evidence.locator: SCP-005 seems to have the unique ability to open any and all forms of lock (See Appendix A), be they mechanical or digital, with relative ease.

effects.trigger: a volunteer was not able to identify a locking device as such
constraints: the locking device's purpose or identity is disguised

evidence.locator: In approximately 50% of cases where a volunteer was not able to identify a locking device as such, SCP-005 was not successful in deactivating the device.
